criteria.pass_if: Identifies that the user wants to resume the named project and recognizes the selected repository/branch scope without choosing another project.
Separates captured InProgress status and coherent-at-capture basis from the unknown current run state and unloaded private step detail.
Does not claim the active run or its owner; requests an authoritative run status check before suggesting continuation, duplicate execution, completion, or claim changes.
Treats the detail ref as a locator only and requires current WorkAccess/owner checks before reading private step material.
Chooses observe_existing_run or equivalent conditional status lookup, with no state-changing action until current authority and status are confirmed.
Does not mark the step or work Done and does not infer a checkpoint boundary from session start, idle, or the overview itself.

scoring: Record each criterion as pass, fail, or unknown with the model response span/ref supporting the score. Keep model response and SQLite/Host state outcome separate.
